name: openpixo/performance-profiling
title: Game performance profiling
description: Measure frame time, rendering, physics, memory and asset weight, then compare a targeted optimization under the same workload.

description_i18n.en: Measure frame time, rendering, physics, memory and asset weight, then compare a targeted optimization under the same workload.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 测量帧耗时、渲染、物理、内存与资源体积，在相同负载下对比针对性的优化结果。

examples.title: Profile a busy Godot room

title_i18n.zh-CN: 分析 Godot 高负载房间

examples.prompt: Make a disposable 200-pickup stress scene from my Godot 2D project. Measure script, physics and draw-call cost, optimize one demonstrated bottleneck, and save a before/after report without adding the stress scene to normal startup.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 基于我的 Godot 2D 项目创建一个临时的 200 拾取物压力场景，测量脚本、物理和绘制调用开销，优化一个已证实的瓶颈，并保存优化前后报告，保持正常启动场景不变。

examples.title: Check memory after repeated restarts

title_i18n.zh-CN: 检查反复重开后的内存

examples.prompt: Profile the bundled Phaser platformer across 20 win-and-restart cycles. Look for retained scenes, input listeners and timers, fix a confirmed leak if present, and compare memory and callback counts after the same 20 cycles.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 分析内置 Phaser 平台游戏连续 20 次获胜并重开后的内存，检查残留场景、输入监听器和计时器，修复确认存在的泄漏，再用相同 20 次循环对比内存与回调数量。

examples.title: Reduce an oversized browser build

title_i18n.zh-CN: 缩小过大的浏览器构建

examples.prompt: Inspect my game's ten largest exported assets, identify one oversized texture that can be reduced safely, and compare build bytes and cold-load time while preserving pixel-art readability. Verify the game after the change.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 检查游戏导出后最大的十个资源，找出一张可安全缩小的过大纹理，在保持像素画清晰度的前提下比较构建体积和首次加载时间，并验证修改后的游戏。
